div.head: Grið 23.1
div.ab: Swylc understandað þa ðe Godes ege habbað ⁊ wisdomes gymað.
Swylc understandað þa ðe Godes ege habbað and wisdomes gymað.
Solches begreifen die, welche Gottesfurcht haben und auf Weisheit achten.
Those understand such things who have the fear of God and heed wisdom.
This is understood by those who have a fear of God and heed wisdom.
div.note: fear of God and heed wisdom: See Proverbs 1:7.

note.seg: Nicht: ‘damit versteht er die’. Vielmehr treten diese Weisen, die understandað, in Ggs. zu den Toren (21, 1), die ne understandan
Not: ‘by this he understands those’. Rather, these wise men, who understandað, are contrasted with the fools (21, 1), who ne understandan
